title: Remove three endpoint reversals from physical convolution (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped program-refinement proof with finite physical corroboration. The complete normalized convolution of Jose Manuel / jmbarrancoml's #3709 can omit the three endpoint reversal routines inherited from #3640, retaining bit-for-bit output equality and the same borrowed-port contract.

```text
F_raw = B F
P(Bx, By) = B P(x, y)
G_raw(x) = G(Bx)
```

Thus the common frequency permutation cancels through the actual record-local polynomial consumer. For axis bit lengths a_i and P=p+sum a_i, this removes exactly `3 ceil(E/b)` outer sparse-router invocations, where `E=sum floor(a_i/2)` and `b=2^floor(997 floor(log2 P)/1000)`. The nonidentity-B four-address fixture removes three. There is no measured runtime factor, changed recursive supplier histogram, new kappa or selected-frontier change.

This answers #3640 Open next question 2 using #3709's later physical product. Compatible DIF/DIT ordering is classical and already appears in the upstream raw interface, androolloyd's indexed-read #673 integration and #3709's inner coefficient FFT. The new contribution is its executable refinement of this particular outer fixed-tape caller, the complete rounded-output/ownership argument and exact batching reduction. Predecessor theorems are cited dependencies, not re-audited deliverables. Produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence

- Before: the source caller materializes B after each forward transform and before the opposite transform, with `ceil(E/b)` nonempty routing batches each. After: the new private Fourier adapter omits those three routines inside the unchanged complete Convolution caller.
- The changed physical caller returns the exact original natural-order oracle output: 224 bit symbols, width 7, SHA256 `ad81a1219dc838dd3cd05b2aa4fb93aa80b7dee0edc77c4e0fb3b149482da8e9`. It retains six roots, three diagonals, three lifts, three truncations, the polynomial product and final M scale, with zero outer reversals. Borrowed data/flags/counts, scratch erasure and protected width-port rejection pass.
- Exact algebra checks cover 24 rounded packets / 4,248 output coefficients, product equivariance on 4,248 coefficients, all six asymmetric omission counterexamples, 25 enumerated routing-batch cases and five invalid geometries. Normal and optimized modes pass.
- All three registered checks pass in 296.08 seconds total. Separately timed direct normal and optimized algebra checks each take 0.92 seconds; the direct physical check takes 298.24 seconds. These are validation durations, not a speed comparison. Environment: macOS 27.0.1 arm64, CPython 3.12.15, standard library.
- Metadata/pins, exact committed bytes, executable modes and source-history preflight pass at `d1f912d9c431414c7ea639baab0415c7183958d7`. The official export checks all 13 declared inputs. Read-only, empty-PATH, Git-free optimized algebra replay passes; deliberate source corruption rejects, and all 24 exported files retain their original bytes after the control.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/reversal-free-convolution/verify.py --mode algebra
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/reversal-free-convolution/verify.py --mode algebra
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/reversal-free-convolution/verify.py --mode physical
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/reversal-free-convolution
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/reversal-free-convolution --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Any CPython 3.12 executable can replace the local path. Expected markers are `PASS_REVERSAL_FREE_CONVOLUTION`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Direct checks generate stdout receipts bound to all package-file hashes. No receipt is handwritten. Exact live source pins and historical task provenance are in SOURCES.json.

## Limitations

The proof assumes the retained complete Fourier and record-local product contracts, including their exact-grid/native/tape premises. The finite physical fixture uses the inherited direct/literal q2 child and reduced test guards. Production GL64/O73 execution, optimized full physical replay, Lean, Docker, the selected cold replay and the Gaussian/CRT/integer join were not run. No selected framework assumption is discharged. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The raw Fourier convention is private to the complete convolution adapter. A standalone natural-order transform still requires the original Fourier API. The stated router count excludes routing internal to roots and the polynomial product.

## Open next questions

- Bind the adapter to one complete physical Gaussian or CRT caller, first proving its input disk margin, output width/narrowing and complete field layout. The retained precision and integer-recovery obligations remain blockers.
- Instantiate the exact removed-routing formula on one production-sized encoded shape and retain its complete supplier ledger. A measured runtime factor requires a separate experiment.

## Related open work

- #5946 determines maximal restricted-input dimensions for unequal Fourier read maps. It supplies an algebraic input-space contract, while this contribution keeps both operands unrestricted and implements a common internal frequency convention in the physical #3640/#3709 caller. No shared numerical value is compared.

The live source-specific open-PR searches found no other PR targeting this caller's outer endpoint reversals. Main and live handoffs were refreshed before committing. The advance claim is https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19228351.
